# BrainDump

> Talk messy, paste clean. BrainDump is a macOS menu-bar app (fork of open-wispr) that transcribes speech with Whisper and cleans it up with a small local AI model before pasting.

- **Source / install**: https://github.com/madeby10am/braindump
- **Requires**: Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 13+, Homebrew, Xcode command-line tools
- **Privacy**: speech and formatting run locally (whisper.cpp + llama.cpp). No cloud, no accounts, no API keys.
- **Styles**: Clean Up, Claude Prompt, Email, Slack, Custom
- **Other audio**: not lowered while dictating by default (opt-in setting)
- **License**: MIT. Based on open-wispr by Ammon Taylor.
